whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. Alok / Alok Dental Care Team,

I noticed your dental clinic has earned exceptional 4.8★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct patient appointment bookings.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, dental services menu, aur patient testimonials integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/alokdental

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Alok Dental Care Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp patient booking and mobile-first speed for Kankarbagh patients. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
